decision.title: XML 1.0 grammar
decision.summary: sxml has its own tree-sitter grammar for XML 1.0 in grammars/xml, with an external scanner holding element names on an interned tag stack, and leaves the remaining well-formedness checks to the tree builder.

body.p: . grammars/xml is written for sxml, not vendored: tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-xml (MIT) was studied but is too lenient and its tag-stack scanner is unsafe for deep or non-ASCII documents (reasons in grammars/xml/README.md; credit in grammars/xml/NOTICE).

item.p: Node names spell out the XML 1.0 production names in snake_case (STag is start_tag, CharData is character_data); names, values and identifiers are fields. Content items are direct children of element.

External scanner (src/scanner.c): element names on a tag stack, so a mismatched end tag is an ERROR (WFC Element Type Match); character data, CDATA text, comment text and PI content with their delimiters and [2] Char; PI targets other than xml. The stack is a persistent, interned table of (parent frame, name) pairs owned by the scanner; the serialized state is one 4-byte frame index, so depth and name length are unlimited. The scanner allocates through ts_malloc/ts_calloc/ts_realloc ( exemption).

Only the document and its internal subset are parsed; parameter-entity references inside internal-subset declarations are a grammar error (WFC PEs in Internal Subset). The external subset and text declarations have no grammar.
Every well-formedness check the grammar cannot make is listed in grammars/xml/README.md ("What the tree builder checks"). Entity replacement text is checked by parsing it wrapped in a dummy element.
grammars/CMakeLists.txt registers every grammars/<language>/src/parser.c with sxml_add_grammar; a new grammar needs no CMake edit.

Measured: W3C XML suite (standalone, XML 1.0 Fifth Edition) valid 601/601 and invalid 175/175 parse cleanly, not-wf 870/948 rejected by the grammar (the other 78 are builder constraints); all 3583 well-formed UTF-8 *.xml files of the QT4 and XSLT 4.0 suites parse cleanly.
